title: How to Set the Total Number of Member Search Results per Page | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Set the Total Number of Member Search Results per Page Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101931 To determine the number of search results displayed on your search pages, follow these steps: Go to My Content . Click on Edit Post Settings. Find the Member Listings post type. Look for the tab labeled Search Results Design . Here, you can control how many results appear by default using the Search Results per Page setting. Designate a numerical value to specify the total number of listings/profiles that appear per page. This setting controls how many total results will appear on a search results page by default. NOTE : Recommended Maximum Limit 500 in order to maintain optimal website speed For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
